\csc (2^{k}x)=\cot(2^{k-1}x)-\cot(2^{k}x).

Summing from \(k=0\) to \(k=n-1\) telescopes:

\[
\csc x+\csc(2x)+\dots+\csc(2^{\,n-1}x)=\cot\frac{x}{2}-\cot(2^{\,n-1}x).
\]

Hence  

\[
S_n=-\frac{d}{dx}\Bigl[\cot\frac{x}{2}-\cot(2^{\,n-1}x)\Bigr]
   =\frac12\csc^{2}\frac{x}{2}-2^{\,n-1}\csc^{2}\bigl(2^{\,n-1}x\bigr).
\]

In terms of sine,

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle S_n=\frac{1}{2\sin^{2}\!\frac{x}{2}}-\frac{2^{\,n-1}}
{\sin^{2}\!\bigl(2^{\,n-1}x\bigr)} } ,
\qquad x\not\equiv0\pmod{\pi}.
\]<|eot_id|> <|end_of_text|>
